subject: MSA & Order Form intake — template routing and risk triage
messages:

Date: 2025-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + MSA / Order Form for Redwood evaluation

Hi Kimberly / Redwood team,

Thanks for the demo last week — we liked the latency and cost controls. Our procurement team asked me to kick off contracting so we can run a 60-day pilot. Attaching AstraHealth's preferred MSA and a purchase order template (po_5421.docx) for the pilot scope.

Key asks up front:
- Please confirm which MSA template you want to use (we typically accept redlines to ours).
- We need standard SOC2 + data processing docs for review (PII handling, retention).
- Target go-live: 2025-07-20 (pilot start).

Attaching: astra_msa_draft.pdf, po_5421.docx

Let me know the intake steps and who on your side will lead legal/commercial.

Best,
Elena Gomez
Senior Sourcing Manager, AstraHealth
elena.gomez@astrahealth.com
Phone: (415) 555-0123
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA / Order Form for Redwood evaluation

Hi Elena — thanks for the materials and quick follow-up. I’ll coordinate intake from Redwood’s side. A few items to align on before we proceed with redlines:

1) Template preference: we can start from your MSA or use our Redwood MSA. If you prefer to keep your template, we’ll propose a focused set of changes. If you want our template, we’ll send it over for your review. Which would you prefer?

2) Party details: please confirm the contracting entity name, billing address, and signatory name/title for AstraHealth. I’ll attach a short party matrix to capture this.

3) Security evidence: we’ll attach our SOC2 summary and DPA draft. Can you confirm whether AstraHealth needs encryption/HSM details or an on-premises deployment appendix?

4) Timeline & milestones: you noted a 7/20 pilot start. To meet that, we’d like to finish commercial redlines and sign by 7/03 to allow provisioning. Is that feasible for your legal/procurement team?

Next steps: I’m attaching our Redwood MSA template (redwood_msa_template_v2.pdf) and an intake_party_matrix.xlsx. If you confirm template choice and party details by EOD tomorrow, we’ll have an initial redline back in 2-3 business days.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa (legal) and Jonas (contracts) for intake sync and to flag any high-risk clauses.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MSA / Order Form for Redwood evaluation

Thanks Kimberly / Elena — I reviewed the Astra MSA quickly. High-level intake notes for the team (and Elena for visibility):

- Priority flags: indemnity – mutual carve to limited to gross negligence, data-specific indemnity language; liability cap currently set at 12 months revenue — we should propose 12 months of fees for the pilot or a negotiated cap tied to pilot value.
- Data processing: Astra’s DPA references subprocessor lists and export controls. We will provide our standard DPA and confirm subprocessors.
- Audit rights / SOC2: Astra requests on-site audit language; we should propose SOC2 report + remote evidence instead of on-site for now.
- IP: ensure a customer data definition and clear license grant for model outputs (redwood grants runtime outputs; customer retains input ownership).
- Confidentiality / retention: propose a 90-day data retention default for pilot logs, with extension options.
- Insurance: Astra requests evidence; ask for policy limits and broker contact if needed.

I attached a tracked redline (redlined_msa_kp_v1.docx) with targeted edits and a short intake checklist. Major asks we can concede for pilot: reduced liability cap per pilot sizing, limited indemnity, standard DPA. We’ll need confirmation of contracting entity and signatory to produce a clean counter.

Elena: if you can fill the intake_party_matrix.xlsx (I highlighted required cells) and confirm whether Astra insists on your MSA rather than ours, we’ll prioritize the appropriate template.

Kimberly — assuming party info comes back quickly, I’ll aim to send an initial counter with tracked changes by 6/20 EOD.

- Marissa
Associate Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@astrahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Intro + MSA / Order Form for Redwood evaluation

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick review and the redline. I filled the intake_party_matrix.xlsx (attached) — contracting entity is AstraHealth, Inc.; billing address is 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103; signatory is Elena Gomez, VP, Strategic Sourcing.

A couple of clarifications from our side:
- We prefer to start from our MSA (familiar to our internal teams), but we’re open to Redwood’s DPA and SOC2 evidence instead of an on-site audit.
- Liability cap: for pilot purposes we can accept a capped liability equal to 6 months of pilot fees; we noted your suggested 12 months, but will need procurement sign-off.
- Pilot scope: up to 10k prompts/day and up to 100 concurrent sessions for 60 days.

Attached: intake_party_matrix_filled.xlsx, po_5421.docx

Targeting to have procurement and legal alignment by end of next week (6/27). If you can get an initial counter by 6/20, that gives our team time to review.

Best,
Elena

- Legal counter path: Marissa will prepare targeted redlines to Astra’s MSA and include our DPA as an exhibit. Marissa, please confirm whether you want me to upload the redlined doc to HubSpot or send direct to Astra?

- HubSpot: I uploaded intake and attached files: https://hubspot.com/deal/5047
- Communication plan: propose a one-hour sync on 6/22 to review major redlines (Marissa + Kimberly + Astra points). Are you both available?

Kimberly — if you’re good with Marissas approach, I’ll queue the redline to go out to Astra on 6/20 EOD.
